##### Project general facts

Amali Residences stands as a waterfront masterpiece composed of two sleek towers linked by fully appointed podiums, creating an urban sanctuary that feels like a resort. The development offers a curated portfolio of one‑, two‑, three‑, four‑ and five‑bedroom homes, alongside rare duplexes and limited‑edition penthouses distinguished by double‑height ceilings, private pools and sweeping vistas. Architectural intent is expressed through a sculptural silhouette that frames the glittering skyline while embracing the riverfront ambience.

Residents can indulge in a swim‑through indoor‑outdoor pool that merges seamlessly with a family lagoon featuring a swim‑up bar, alongside vitality pools designed for rejuvenation. Wellness is further supported by a spa equipped with sauna and steam room, dedicated yoga and Pilates studios, and a private cinema and bowling alley for entertainment. Business and leisure converge in spaces such as a resident’s library, cigar lounge, member’s club lounge, chef‑curated dining with a teppanyaki grill, executive boardroom, co‑working studies and a sky terrace that captures sunset panoramas.

The interiors celebrate artisanal craftsmanship, showcasing hand‑finished Joseph Giles ironmongery, state‑of‑the‑art Gaggenau appliances and innovative smart home technology. Expansive picture windows flood each residence with natural light, opening onto double‑height terraces adorned with lush foliage. Every detail is orchestrated to harmonise light, shadow and the surrounding cityscape in a refined living experience. 

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay pulses with energy as one of the city’s most prestigious waterfront districts, where world‑class hotels, fine‑dining venues and striking contemporary bridges shape an unparalleled urban playground. The Dubai Canal weaves through the neighbourhood, turning the area into a serene waterway that offers breathtaking panoramas at every turn. Its central positioning places the city’s most iconic landmarks within effortless reach, establishing it as a highly connected address.

The enclave enjoys unrivalled accessibility, with the towering Burj Khalifa and the bustling Dubai International Financial Centre merely minutes away, while Meydan, Dubai International Airport, Dubai Harbour and Emirates Golf Club lie close at hand. Major thoroughfares thread through the district, delivering seamless travel across the wider metropolis, and the tranquil waterfront backdrop provides a peaceful counterpoint to city life. This blend of swift connectivity and soothing ambience enriches everyday experiences.

Beyond the immediate skyline, residents find a wealth of attractions, from the pristine sands of Kite Beach and Jumeirah Beach to the opulent allure of Palm Jumeirah and the iconic silhouette of Burj Al Arab. Cultural venues, elite banks and vibrant art galleries populate the streets, adding layers of sophistication to daily routines. Proximity to the international airport and a dedicated private‑jet terminal ensures that global travel remains effortlessly convenient.
